Hey friends, if you’ve ever felt like you’re “winning” on paper (good job, good salary, impressive titles) but still feel weirdly empty inside, this video is for you. I sat down with Paul Millerd (author of The Pathless Path and Good Work) to break down a 10-step roadmap for quitting the default path without needing some perfect master plan, from running the numbers to dealing with the shame and fear that comes up. Hope you enjoy xx

videos.title: Essentials: Sleep Toolkit for Optimizing Sleep & Sleep-Wake Timing
videos.description:
In this ⁠Huberman Lab Essentials⁠ episode, I discuss science-supported tools to improve sleep by supporting a healthy circadian rhythm using key behaviors and environmental cues. I explain specific morning, afternoon and evening behaviors that will increase daytime alertness and support deeper, more consistent sleep at night. I also cover sleep supplements, the effects of caffeine, alcohol and THC on sleep, as well as practical strategies for managing jet lag and shift work.
